verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents first-party natural-language operation. Its Composer agent takes a stated goal and builds the audience, drafts content and maps the send strategy. The official MCP server also accepts prompts such as "Create an email campaign promoting our Memorial Day sale" for tasks ranging from campaign creation to performance reports. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work as claimed, and documentation of which operations are supported (Composer only makes "supported changes").

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Tell Composer what you're trying to achieve, and it'll build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy.
Composer can make supported changes, build marketing for your review, and help carry the work through, with you in control.
The AI marketing and service platform built to deliver personalized, omnichannel campaigns and 24/7 support—all from a single prompt.
Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.
Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
